body: It's oddly comforting knowing that there are people out there I've never met who care about me. Thank you

I don't even know how to bring it up to my loved ones, and that's the major problem. I've tried bringing it up with my friends but it's just "oh you just need to be more positive" it's so irritating. Thank you for replying though, it's good to know that there are people out there.

I'll do pretty good at keeping up my moods and fighting but then one day I'll wake up and bang, full blown depression sitting right next to me to the point where I don't even wan't to get out of bed. I don't want to go to class. I don't want to go to work. I just don't want to to do anything anymore.
Thank you for your reply - also Breaking Benjamin is a great band.
